edgar_concentrations.excerpt: Contract and other revenue accounted for 13% and 12% of our consolidated revenue for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, as compared to 11% for both the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025. 25 Costs and Expenses Cost of product revenue mainly includes costs attributable to the sale of memory interface chip products. Cost of product revenue increased approximately $11.2 million and $21.5 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, as compared to the same periods in 2025. The increases were primarily due to additional inventory and production costs to support higher sales volumes of our memory interface chips. Cost of contract and other revenue reflects the portion of the total engineering costs that is specifically devoted to individual customer development and support services. Cost of contract and other revenue increased $0.3 million and $1.0 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, as compared to the same periods in 2025. The increases were primarily due to higher costs of engineering services associated with the contracts. Total research and development expenses for the three months ended September 30, 2026 are consistent with amounts from the same period in 2025, decreasing by approximately $0.1 million. The slight decrease was primarily due to a $1.9 million reduction in prototyping costs, partially offset by increases of $1.2 million in stock-based compensation expenses and $1.0 million in payroll-related expenses. Total research and development expenses for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 increased approximately $12.2 million as compared to the same period in 2025. The increase was primarily driven by continued investment in our research and development initiatives and reflected higher payroll-related expenses of $7.2 million, stock-based compensation expenses of $2.6 million, depreciation expense of $1.8 million and prototyping costs of $0.8 million, partially offset by decreases in other research and development expenses. Total sales, general and administrative expenses for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased approximately $8.5 million as compared to the same period in 2025, primarily due to increases in professional fees of $5.2 million, stock-based compensation expenses of $1.8 million and payroll-related expenses of $1.1 million.

items.claim: CFO 給 Q3 總營收財測區間 2.10–2.16 億美元
items.quote: third quarter to be between $210 million and $216 million.
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 給 Q3 產品營收財測 1.10–1.16 億美元，中點季增 14%
items.quote: $110 million and $116 million, a sequential increase of 14% at the midpoint of guidance.
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 給 Q3 權利金營收財測 6,900–7,500 萬美元（Q2 實際為 8,420 萬）
items.quote: royalties revenue to be between $69 million and $75 million
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 給 Q3 非 GAAP EPS 財測 0.75–0.82 美元
items.quote: non-GAAP earnings per share range between $0.75 and $0.82.
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 表示下半年將強於上半年，並維持逐季給財測、不給一季以後
items.quote: our second half is going to be stronger than our first half
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明財測僅逐季提供
items.quote: but we will continue to guide quarter-by-quarter.
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示矽智財業務維持年增 10%–15%
items.quote: we continue to see that business growing 10% to 15% a year
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示 MRDIMM 於 Q4 貢獻極小，較實質貢獻在 2027
items.quote: The contribution for Q4 is going to be minimal.
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 指出 MRDIMM 較實質貢獻發生在 2027 平台放量時
items.quote: contribution is going to happen in 2027 when both platforms from the CPU guys
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示新產品占產品營收比重預計到 Q4 底達中雙位數百分比
items.quote: And that's going to be in the mid double digits
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明 Q3 產品營收年增幅度與本季相近
items.quote: Next quarter, we're going to see the same growth
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: 管理層重申毛利率長期模型 60%–65%，並表示季間會波動
items.quote: Our model remains 60% to 65%
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 指出近期毛利率落在 60%–63%
items.quote: we've been operating in the 60% to 63% gross margin
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 宣布此後財報與財測只以 ASC 606 營收口徑呈現，不再揭露授權帳單（billings）
items.quote: guidance on an ASC 606 revenue basis going forward.
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 報告 Q2 營收 2.074 億美元
items.quote: Revenue for the second quarter was $207.4 million
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 表示 Q2 無產能問題（同時提到供應鏈緊俏、交期拉長）
items.quote: we didn't have any capacity issue in Q2
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示公司想維持或提高 DIMM 市占（標準品無漲價空間）
items.quote: maintain or continue to increase our share in the DIMM market.
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示產品投資將集中於標準品，而非 CXL 類客製 ASIC 產品
items.quote: we'd rather invest into standard products at this point in time.
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 表明其工作重點之一為審慎配置資本
items.quote: allocate capital thoughtfully
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 報告期末現金及有價證券 8.25 億美元，較 Q1 增加 3,900 萬
items.quote: marketable securities totaling $825 million, up $39 million from Q1
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 說明 Q2 存貨增加 1,600 萬美元，用於支援產品放量與供貨保證
items.quote: Inventory increased by $16 million during the quarter
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 說明公司對關鍵產品建立策略性庫存
items.quote: We build strategic inventory for the
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 報告 Q2 自由現金流 4,900 萬美元
items.quote: Free cash flow in the quarter was $49 million.
items.speaker: Sumeet Gagneja (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 表示 2027 年供應限制仍將存在
items.quote: the supply constraints will continue to be there in 2027.
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示對需求假設有信心，但對平台時程與供應採審慎態度
items.quote: we are prudent with respect to platform timing and supply
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 指出平台放量歷來比外界預期慢
items.quote: platform ramps typically take a little bit
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 回答客戶端無過度備貨跡象
items.quote: We don't see any signs of our customers building inventory
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示標準品沒有漲價空間
items.quote: we don't see any opportunity, I would say, for
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: 新任 CFO 在本次法說首度亮相
items.quote: welcome Sumeet Gagneja to his first earnings call
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 提到 Q1 曾有製造問題，仍年增 15%
items.quote: despite the manufacturing issue we had, it was 15% higher
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明新產品目前占產品營收低雙位數百分比
items.quote: were in a low double-digit percentage of the product revenue.
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示 LPDDR/SOCAMM 短期營收貢獻有限，但策略重要性高
items.quote: the short run is modest, but the strategic importance is really high for us.
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 認為產業並未轉向 LPDDR，LPDDR 屬增量機會
items.quote: I wouldn't say that the industry is shifting to LPDDR.
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明 MRDIMM 模組上的矽含量為 4 倍
items.quote: MRDIMM with 4x the silicon content on the module
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明 PCIe 7.0 授權收入在未來幾季出現，不需等終端產品放量
items.quote: in the coming quarters, because it's a licensing business
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 描述 CXL 產品市場呈客製 ASIC、分散化
items.quote: a custom ASIC business that is fragmented for us
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 回應 CXMT：記憶體廠商都需與 Rambus 簽授權
items.quote: has to have a license agreement with us
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示伺服器單位成長預期由中高個位數升至雙位數，公司自認成長快於市場
items.quote: Now it's double-digit growth.
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 揭露與一家美國一線超大規模雲端業者的下一代 HBM 設計案
items.quote: an exciting design win with a Tier 1 U.S. hyperscaler
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 確認該設計案為 IP 而非晶片產品
items.quote: It's an IP design win
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明該 IP 為授權模式而非按量計價
items.quote: it's a license or multi-license
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示超大規模雲端業者在定義自家架構上角色日增
items.quote: hyperscalers are playing a growing role
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示對需求的信心持續增加
items.quote: I think our confidence is continuing to build.
items.speaker: Luc Seraphin (CEO)
